description: Peter Mandelson was arrested at an address in Camden, London on suspicion of misconduct in public office and taken to a London police station for interview. A Metropolitan Police spokesperson said, "Officers have arrested a 72-year-old man on suspicion of misconduct in public office," and that the arrest followed search warrants executed at two addresses in the Wiltshire and Camden areas earlier in the month. The force said it was "not able to provide further information at this stage to prevent prejudicing the integrity of the investigation." Mandelson was released on bail pending further investigation the following day. He has denied wrongdoing and has not been charged with any offence.
headline: Peter Mandelson Arrested on Suspicion of Misconduct in Public Office

info.description: The Metropolitan Police confirmed his release on bail in a statement issued at 02:05 on February 24, 2026.
info.note: The statement read, "A 72-year-old man arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office has been released on bail pending further investigation." The force did not name the man in either statement; this is normal, however, the arrest briefings have since been taken down.
